name: Shakti Scheme (Karnataka)
short_description: Free bus travel for all women residents of Karnataka across state-run RTC ordinary and express buses.
detailed_description: The Shakti scheme offers free travel for women, girls, and transgender persons who are permanent residents of Karnataka in non-luxury buses operated by KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC across Karnataka state.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು, ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿನಿಯರು ಮತ್ತು ತೃತೀಯಲಿಂಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೆ.ಎಸ್.ಆರ್.ಟಿ.ಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿ.ಎಂ.ಟಿ.ಸಿ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಬಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Govt Order No. TD 43 SL 2023, Bengaluru, dated 05-06-2023
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Female or Transgender
rules.source_citation: Govt Order No. TD 43 SL 2023, Clause 2 (Eligible Beneficiaries)

benefits_summary: 100% free bus fare across all non-AC state transport buses in Karnataka.
required_documents: Any Govt-issued photo ID showing Karnataka address (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving Licence)
application_process: Present a government-issued address proof to the bus conductor inside any eligible state transport bus to receive a zero-fare ticket.
source_excerpt: Free travel is permitted to all women domiciled in Karnataka in KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC ordinary and express buses.
